t: Above you is the ArcelorMittal Orbit, a 114.5-metre sculpture and observation tower in Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park. It is Britain's largest piece of public art, intended as a lasting legacy of London's 2012 Olympic and Paralympic Games. It stands between London Stadium and the Aquatics Centre, and two platforms let visitors look out over the whole park. It was made by the artist Anish Kapoor together with the structural engineer and artist Cecil Balmond.
